notes: Unified 4-model pool for dual-router SWERouterBench benchmarking (UncommonRoute vs semantic-router KNN). IDs taken verbatim from OpenRouter /api/v1/models on 2026-04-22. Exactly one is_high_baseline=true (anthropic/claude-opus-4.6) drives failure-rerun charge. provider='openai_compat' universally (OpenRouter returns OpenAI-compat usage envelopes). cache_control_style='anthropic' only for Claude family so the harness injects ephemeral cache_control blocks; others rely on provider-side cache accounting.
